records.source: Ahoy there! It's nice to see young folk movin' in to the valley. It's not very common these days.
records.translation: Ahoy! Masayang makitang may mga kabataang lumilipat sa lambak. Hindi na iyon pangkaraniwan ngayon.

records.source: By the stem o' me pipe...  a cup o' Stardrop Tea! And here I thought it was only the stuff of mermaid legend. Thank you kindly.
records.translation: Sa tangkay ng pipa ko... isang tasa ng Tsaa ng Patak-Bituin! Akala ko, sa mga alamat lamang ng sirena iyon. Maraming salamat.

records.source: Aye...  A timeless classic. Brings a tear to me eye, with every read. A fisherman can never have too many copies! Thank ye.$h
records.translation: Oo... Isang klasikong walang kupas. Napapaluha ako sa bawat pagbasa. Hindi kailanman sosobra ang mga kopya para sa isang mangingisda! Salamat.$h

records.source: Thank ye! This'll be perfect winter reading. Ah, and it even smells of the sea...$h
records.translation: Salamat! Perpekto itong basahin sa taglamig. Ah, at amoy-dagat pa...$h

records.source: Ah, 'Bait And Bobber'... Every angler ought to have a subscription, but it costs a pretty penny. Taught me a lot of good fishin' tips over the years. Thanks!$h
records.translation: Ah, “Pain at Palutang”... Dapat may suskripsiyon ang bawat mangingisda, pero napakamahal. Marami akong natutuhang magagandang payo sa pangingisda mula rito sa paglipas ng mga taon. Salamat!$h

records.source: Ah, this stuff warms the ol' bones. Thank you.
records.translation: Ah, pinaiinit nito ang mga buto ko. Salamat.

records.source: Aye... I hope these weird rains don't bother the fish... It could ruin me life!
records.translation: Oo... Sana hindi naaabala ng kakaibang ulang ito ang mga isda... Maaari nitong sirain ang buhay ko!

records.source: Well, the fish seem as healthy as ever. In fact, I swear they've been biting with extra vigor!
records.translation: Aba, mukhang malulusog pa rin ang mga isda gaya ng dati. Sa katunayan, tiyak kong mas masigla silang kumakagat!

records.source: If the fish like these rains, then I like 'em, too.
records.translation: Kung gusto ng mga isda ang ulang ito, gusto ko rin.

records.source: Ah... That's the perfect bait for a catfish I've been tryin' to catch!#$b#Here, let me trade you this for it. I'm not sure what it is, but it washed up on the beach not too long ago.#$b#Somethin' tells me you could use it, lad.^Somethin' tells me you could use it, miss.
records.translation: Ah... Perpektong pain iyan para sa hitong matagal ko nang sinusubukang hulihin!#$b#Heto, ipagpapalit ko ito roon. Hindi ko tiyak kung ano ito, pero napadpad ito sa dalampasigan kamakailan.#$b#May nagsasabi sa aking magagamit mo ito, binata.^May nagsasabi sa aking magagamit mo ito, dalaga.

records.source: The horror! ...What kind of monster is this?
records.translation: Nakakakilabot! ...Anong uri ng halimaw ito?

records.source: *chomp*... Yep, that's real gold alright. Heh! What a gift!$h
records.translation: *nguya*... Oo, tunay na ginto nga iyan. Heh! Napakagandang regalo!$h

records.source: Giving up the ${bachelor^single}$ life, eh?#$b#Just don't forget to make time for fishing...
records.translation: Iiwan mo na ang ${pagkabinata^pagkadalaga}$, ano?#$b#Huwag mo lang kalimutang maglaan ng oras sa pangingisda...

records.source: Ah, you caught the Angler, did ya? A good 'first step' into the world o' rare fish, that one.
records.translation: Ah, nahuli mo ang Angler, ano? Magandang “unang hakbang” ang isang iyan sa mundo ng mga bihirang isda.

records.source: So, you finally conquered the Crimsonfish! That fish has been taunting me for many years. He nearly nibbled through the wood under me house!
records.translation: Kaya sa wakas, nadaig mo ang Isdang Krimson! Maraming taon akong kinutya ng isdang iyon. Muntik na niyang nguyain ang kahoy sa ilalim ng bahay ko!

records.source: By the stem o' me pipe... You actually caught 'the Legend'. I never thought I'd see the day...$h#$b#Well, lad, you've done it... You're the best fisherman this valley's seen in a long time...$h^Well, miss, you've done it... You're the best angler this valley's seen in a long time...$h
records.translation: Sa tangkay ng pipa ko... Nahuli mo talaga ang “Alamat”. Hindi ko inakalang makikita ko ang araw na ito...$h#$b#Aba, binata, nagawa mo... Ikaw ang pinakamahusay na mangingisdang nakita ng lambak sa napakatagal na panahon...$h^Aba, dalaga, nagawa mo... Ikaw ang pinakamahusay na mangingisdang nakita ng lambak sa napakatagal na panahon...$h

records.source: Ah, so you finally snagged the Glacierfish... That's one of the slipperiest fish I've ever encountered!#$e#How many tries did it take ya?
records.translation: Ah, kaya sa wakas ay nahuli mo ang Isdang Glasyar... Isa iyon sa pinakamadudulas na isdang nakatagpo ko!#$e#Ilang beses mong sinubukan?

records.source: *sniff* *sniff*... Something tells me you've been fishin' in the sewers, lad.^*sniff* *sniff*... Something tells me you've been fishin' in the sewers, miss.#$b#It's an unconventional approach, to be sure. There's legend of gargantuan carp, twisted into monsters from the toxic sludge...
records.translation: *singhot* *singhot*... May nagsasabi sa aking nangingisda ka sa mga imburnal, binata.^*singhot* *singhot*... May nagsasabi sa aking nangingisda ka sa mga imburnal, dalaga.#$b#Tiyak na di-pangkaraniwang paraan iyon. May alamat ng dambuhalang karpang naging halimaw dahil sa nakalalasong putik...

records.source: *sniff*... Ah... That old familiar scent. You've been raisin' crabs, haven't ya?#$b#Yer a ${man^lady}$ after me own heart, @. Hah!$h#$b#Here, take this. I found it on the beach... Been savin' it fer a special occasion. It's not every day I discover a fellow crab enthusiast! [797]
records.translation: *singhot*... Ah... Ang pamilyar na amoy na iyon. Nag-aalaga ka ng mga alimango, hindi ba?#$b#Isa kang ${lalaki^babae}$ na kapareho ko ng hilig, @. Hah!$h#$b#Heto, kunin mo ito. Nahanap ko sa dalampasigan... Itinatabi ko para sa natatanging pagkakataon. Hindi araw-araw akong nakakahanap ng kapwa mahilig sa alimango! [797]

records.source: Ah... a movie. That's kind of ye, lad.^Ah... a movie. That's kind of ye, miss.#$b#I'll just finish me pipe, and head over.
records.translation: Ah... isang pelikula. Mabait ka, binata.^Ah... isang pelikula. Mabait ka, dalaga.#$b#Uubusin ko lang ang laman ng pipa ko at pupunta na roon.

records.source: Tomorrow is the annual Trout Derby... Aye, it's a freshwater enthusiast's dream!#$e#Anglers from all over the world will be here to catch our beautiful Rainbow Trout...#$e#I'd better see you out there, lad!$h^I hope to see you out there!$h#$e#For the next two days, I'll only be manning the shop for one hour, starting at 9am. So if you really need somethin', you can come by then.
records.translation: Bukas ang taunang Derbi ng Trutsa... Oo, pangarap iyon ng mahilig sa tabang na tubig!#$e#Darating dito ang mga mangingisda mula sa buong mundo upang hulihin ang maganda nating Trutsang Bahaghari...#$e#Dapat makita kita roon, binata!$h^Sana makita kita roon!$h#$e#Sa susunod na dalawang araw, isang oras lamang akong magbabantay sa tindahan simula alas-nuwebe ng umaga. Kaya kung talagang may kailangan ka, dumaan ka sa oras na iyon.

records.source: It's the big day! I've got all me equipment tuned to catch Trout...#$e#Good luck out there!
records.translation: Ito na ang malaking araw! Naiayos ko na ang lahat ng kagamitan ko upang manghuli ng Trutsa...#$e#Suwertehin ka sana!

records.source: How's the Derby treatin' ya so far?#$b#I've found plenty o' Golden Tags, meself... but it's not over yet!
records.translation: Kumusta ang Derbi para sa iyo?#$b#Marami na akong nahanap na Ginintuang Tatak... pero hindi pa tapos!

records.source: Tomorrow, at the beach, is the start of a little gathering... called 'SquidFest'.#$e#Aye... tis' a difficult catch, the squid. But I trust that you've developed a knack for the sport, by now.
records.translation: Bukas, sa dalampasigan, magsisimula ang munting pagtitipong tinatawag na “Pista ng Pusit”.#$e#Oo... Mahirap hulihin ang pusit. Pero nagtitiwala akong nahasa mo na ang galing mo sa gawaing ito.

records.source: Don't give up just yet! There's more squid in these waters...
records.translation: Huwag ka munang susuko! Marami pang pusit sa mga tubig na ito...

records.source: It warms me ol' winter heart to see all these anglers gathered here, all for the love o' fishing...$h
records.translation: Pinaiinit ang puso kong nanlalamig ng lahat ng mangingisdang nagtipon dito dahil sa pagmamahal sa pangingisda...$h

records.source: Ahoy there, son.^Ahoy there, lass.#$b#Looks like decent weather for fishing, eh?
records.translation: Ahoy, anak.^Ahoy, dalaga.#$b#Mukhang magandang panahon para mangisda, ano?

records.source: Have you had much luck in the local waters? You look like you could be a strong angler if you set your mind to it.
records.translation: Sinusuwerte ka ba sa mga tubig dito? Mukhang maaari kang maging mahusay na mangingisda kung pagbubutihin mo.

records.source: A true angler has respect for the water... don't you forget that.
records.translation: Iginagalang ng tunay na mangingisda ang tubig... Huwag mong kalilimutan iyon.

records.source: The ol' Man was a fisherman, you know. I grew up sailing between the fern islands, living from catch to catch.#$e#The fishing life is tough, but there's something about it that keeps you goin'.
records.translation: Mangingisda ang matanda kong ama, alam mo. Lumaki akong naglalayag sa pagitan ng Kapuluan ng Fern at nabubuhay sa bawat huli.#$e#Mahirap ang buhay-mangingisda, pero may kung anong nagbibigay sa iyo ng lakas upang magpatuloy.

records.source: Some fish come and go with the seasons. Others only come out at night or in the rain.
records.translation: May mga isdang dumarating at umaalis kasabay ng mga panahon. Ang iba ay lumalabas lamang sa gabi o sa ulan.

records.source: I've heard a rumor that a special kind of fish can be found in the pools between waterfalls...#$b#If you can reach it with yer rod, that is...
records.translation: May narinig akong sabi-sabing makakahanap ng natatanging uri ng isda sa mga lawa sa pagitan ng mga talon...#$b#Kung maaabot mo iyon ng pamingwit mo...

records.source: *mumble* *mumble* ...Eh? I would tell you about my thoughts, but it's a fisherman's secret.
records.translation: *bulung-bulong* *bulung-bulong*... Ha? Sasabihin ko sana ang iniisip ko, pero lihim iyon ng mangingisda.

records.source: There's rumors of some very rare fish in these parts... but only an experienced angler could stand a chance against them.#$e#You'll need the finest bait you can get if you want a rare fish to bite.
records.translation: May mga sabi-sabi tungkol sa ilang napakabihirang isda sa paligid... pero tanging bihasang mangingisda ang may pagkakataong madaig ang mga iyon.#$e#Kakailanganin mo ang pinakamahusay na pain upang mapakagat ang bihirang isda.

records.source: If you really want to get the fish biting, make sure you put some bait on your hook.
records.translation: Kung talagang gusto mong pakagatin ang mga isda, tiyaking maglagay ng pain sa kawit.

records.source: I'm a simple man... when my pipe is full, I'm happy. When my pipe is empty... well, then I just fill 'er up again.$u
records.translation: Simple akong tao... Kapag punô ang pipa ko, masaya ako. Kapag walang laman ang pipa ko... aba, pupunuin ko lang ulit.$u

records.source: If the local fishing scene got a bit more lively, I might expand the shop's stock.
records.translation: Kung magiging mas masigla ang pangingisda rito, baka dagdagan ko ang paninda ng tindahan.

records.source: How's the fishing life going for ya?#$e#I try to fish as often as possible, but it's not easy when you've got a shop to run.
records.translation: Kumusta ang buhay-mangingisda?#$e#Sinusubukan kong mangisda nang madalas hangga’t maaari, pero hindi madali kapag may tindahang pinatatakbo.

records.source: If you purchase a high quality fishing rod, you'll be able to attach bait and tackle to the line.#$b#Bait causes fish to bite faster. Tackle can make your job a lot easier when reeling fish in.#$e#There's all kinds of tackle, with different perks. They're usually a little flimsy, so don't be surprised if your tackle breaks after a while.
records.translation: Kung bibili ka ng de-kalidad na pamingwit, makakabit ka ng pain at kagamitang pangisda sa linya.#$b#Pinabibilis ng pain ang pagkagat ng isda. Mapadadali ng kagamitang pangisda ang paghila sa isda.#$e#Maraming uri ng kagamitang pangisda na may iba’t ibang pakinabang. Karaniwang medyo marupok ang mga iyon, kaya huwag kang magulat kung masira ang kagamitang pangisda mo kalaunan.

records.source: Hey, it's my skipper, @!$h#$e#I'd give you a discount on bait if I could afford it.$s
records.translation: Uy, ang kapitan kong si @!$h#$e#Bibigyan sana kita ng diskuwento sa pain kung kaya ko.$s

records.source: I don't have high hopes of winning... the fish look nice but they don't exactly smell great...$s
records.translation: Hindi ako gaanong umaasang manalo... Maganda ang hitsura ng mga isda, pero hindi talaga maganda ang amoy...$s

records.source: Wow, I got a low score. I guess Mayor Lewis isn't much of a fish man. Oh well...$s
records.translation: Wow, mababa ang marka ko. Marahil hindi gaanong mahilig sa isda si Mayor Lewis. Ayos lang...$s
